This reads as a usage question, so [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place to continue it.

In [docs/source/tables.rst](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst), `no_wrap` only stops a column from wrapping. `min_width` stops a column from shrinking below a set width, which is the documented way to keep the other columns readable while the last one truncates. Setting `min_width` on the other columns may give the layout you want.

Related earlier report: #2890, which covers `no_wrap` squashing columns below their `min_width`.
